text:
ravi: Heads up — starting a canary bring-up of q6b-int8 on the small production pool. Need a quick checklist: promptset dedupe, labeling priority, golden re-eval, and a perf/quality comparison vs q8b.

sophie: thanks — can you list the exact promptset slice you'll run? we should avoid overlap with the longtail holdout. :eyes:

ravi: will run: promptset v3.2 (short+mid intents), + the 'edgecases-longtail' samplebank subset (10k). I'll produce a dedupe manifest before handoff.

maia: label-ops — can you reserve 200 labeler slots tomorrow 9-12 PT for rapid golden relabel? we'll need quick turnaround for regressions. :raised_hands:

label-ops: noted. reserving 200. what's priority ordering? newmodel-first or golden-first?

jordan: golden-first — catch regressions in the verified anchors ASAP, then expand to sampling anomalies.

ravi: agreed. priority: 1) golden anchors (2k), 2) high-entropy samples from canary (3k), 3) failed-evals from q8b baseline (rest).

maia: on dedupe — please use the new fuzzyhash v2 flow (hash + tokenizer-v2) so we don't miss paraphrase near-dupes. small snippet to run:
```bash
python -m curation.tools.fuzzy_dedupe \  --in promptset_v3.2.json \  --tokenizer tokenizer-v2 
```
add `--threshold 0.82` for conservative merges.

ravi: perfect. i'll push dedupe manifest to /curation/runs/4387654321/dedupe.json and tag the canary.

sophie: for eval harness — run both quality and latency benches. quality: rouge/bertscore + our new hallucination probe. latency: p50/p95 token latency with kv-cache warmups. config snippet: 
```yaml
model: q6b-int8
seq_len: 1024
batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
metrics: [rouge, bertscore, halluc_probe]
```

jordan: also record GPU util and kernel choice mapping — int kernels sometimes pick non-optimal conv paths; we want kernel->latency traces.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary deployment started for q6b-int8 in pool small-canary at 2024-09-12T16:10:12Z.

ravi: running initial quant smoke now. will report perf and a small eval sweep by EOD. if we see >3% quality drop on gold anchors we pause and roll back.

maia: one more thing — sampling overlap: ensure we block any sample that is within 90% similarity to existing golden anchors; otherwise labeler time wasted. I can share the anchor fingerprint list.

label-ops: got it. will set a dynamic filter in queue: `exclude_fingerprint_in(/anchors/438/siglist.json, 0.9)`.

ravi: results (quick): quality delta vs q8b baseline on initial 500 anchors: -1.6% BERTScore, hallucination +0.9%. latency p95 improved ~22%. attaching small CSV to the run.

sophie: that delta is notable but maybe tolerable given latency gain — depends on the use case. run the golden relabel to see human-agreed gap.

jordan: also please include per-intent breakdown — some intents tolerate quantization better.

maia: label-ops, start with intent tiers A/B/C: put A (payment, auth) first. we need zero regression on A.

label-ops: starting A now. will push progress updates to the curation ticket. ETA 6 hours for first 2k.

ravi: I'll open a canary-run ticket with links: dedupe manifest, eval outputs, perf traces, and the fallback plan (auto-fallback to q8b if anchor failures >1% on A intents).

sophie: for rollback threshold, agree on 1% regressions on A intents or any hallucination severity above our set threshold. set alerting in console.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary health: 200/200 checks passed, live traffic at 3% of small-canary pool.

ravi: If labels confirm small but systematic gaps, we can try per-layer mixed-precision (last 4 layers in fp16) on q6b to recover quality. that's the next experiment.

jordan: +1. also try different quant calibration dataset (use gold anchors only vs mixed) — calibration affects rare tokens.

maia: will coordinate golden re-eval after label-ops finishes A tier. then we'll run the full 5k golden comparison.

label-ops: A tier done: 2k anchors relabeled, initial pass shows 0.4% regression on A (within threshold). pushing full diff to /curation/runs/4387654321/golden_diff.csv

sophie: promising. schedule: keep canary running for 24h, collect expanded 5k gold relabel, then decide to promote or fallback.

ravi: thanks team. i'll post the final run summary tomorrow AM with a recommendation (promote / experiment mixed-precision / rollback). tagging @maia @label-ops @sophie for visibility. :shipit:
